title: @我 聚合入口 / 免打扰群 @ 提示（单账号可验部分）

targets.guidance: 会话列表里带免打扰（划线铃铛）图标、且预览中出现 “@” 的群

acceptance.text: 存在 “@我 / Mentions” 聚合入口（列出所有 @ 我的消息）

check.expect: There is a visible entry named like "@我", "Mentions" or "提及" that lists messages mentioning the user

acceptance.text: 免打扰群被 @ 时，会话列表有显著提示（角标/徽标，而不只是小号绿色 “[有人@你]” 文本）

check.expect: In the conversation list, the muted group row that mentions the user shows a prominent badge (a count or @ badge on the avatar or at the right side), not only small green preview text

preconditions.text: 有一个免打扰且被 @ 的群

trigger.text: Improvement request raised by Aiden (P0, scheduled as a key iteration right after the China National Day holiday, i.e. from 2026-10-08). Today, when a user is @-mentioned in a muted (DND) group, the only cue is a small green '[@ mentioned]' text in the conversation-list preview. There is no new-mess

observable.text: (1) Any @-mention addressed to me (direct @me; @All/@Everyone per product rule) always shows a new-message indicator and increments the conversation's unread badge and the global (tab / top-right / app-icon) badge, even when the group is muted — matching WeChat. Muted groups' ordinary (non-@) messages keep the current silent behaviour. (2) A 'Mentions / @Me' list (Slack-style) aggregates every message that @-mentions me, newest first, with sender, group, time, message preview and read/unread state; tapping an item jumps to that message in context.
observable.phenomenon: In a muted group an @-mention only renders a green '[@ mentioned]' text hint in the conversation preview. No new-message indicator, no conversation unread badge, no top-right / tab / app-icon badge count. There is no aggregated view of messages that mention me, so users miss them.
